[{"id": "nnvMTG5Sl5", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude4fPrayer Manual", "col": 12}}, {"id": "B-CtTCmVDX", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The prayers module helps gather, track and manage prayers and prayer requests.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "hkZGijObDP", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "The Prayer workspace contains links to prayer reports and documents.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "w8oEjl0tNc", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83d\ude47Prayer Request", "col": 12}}, {"id": "t25CxbBSfh", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer requests are made by (and prayed for) by church people. Prayer requests can also be submitted via users on the site or anonymously via a web form.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "vKO4mgte4s", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a prayer request, note the following:
- Additional prayer request statuses can be created if needed.
- Additional prayer request types can be created if needed.
- If the request is for a specific person, select the person.
- 'Who Can See It' controls who sees the request:
    - Private: only the person who made it and the pastoral care team (Church Pastoral Care, Church Manager and System Manager users).
    - Prayer Team: also the prayer team.
    - Whole Church: also every member, on the Community Prayer Requests page. Only these requests can go in a bulletin.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "prayer_team_b", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayer team. To add a person to the prayer team, open their user and give it the Church Prayer Team role. On the Community Prayer Requests page, a member of the prayer team sees the Prayer Team requests and the Whole Church requests, and can pray for them. A staff user with this role also sees these requests in the Prayer Request list. The prayer team does not see the Private requests of other people.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "jBxW6do4OH", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "\ud83e\udd32Prayers", "col": 12}}, {"id": "Wh1jXU5eeV", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "Prayers are offered by church people. Prayers may be related to prayer requests.", "col": 12}}, {"id": "AT0xpnyfrl", "type": "paragraph", "data": {"text": "When adding a prayer, note the following:
- Select the person who is saying the prayer.
- A file can be attached if the prayer is a written or recorded prayer.
- Items that were prayed for can be recorded in the 'Prayer Topics' section.
    - Topics can include anything stored in the system (i.e. People, Events, Missionaries, Prayer Requests, etc).
    - Choose the topic type (i.e. Prayer Request), then choose the specific document of that type.", "col": 12}}]
